title: Cheerful House near Coffee, Food + Fenced-in Yard
description:
Spacious but cozy house in the trendy "Nations" area of Nashville. Walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants, shopping, bars & breweries. Nearby spots include Fat Bottom Brewing Co., Hattie B's, Frothy Monkey + more! Only 5 miles to Downtown - the bars on Broadway. Enjoy your coffee on our front porch swing, or back patio area. Fully fenced-in backyard! FREE parking, fully equipped kitchen and laundry in the house. High-speed wifi and Smart TV. Plenty of space for your group to hang out in.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS:

★ Located in a great area of Nashville called The Nations 
★ Walk to restaurants, shopping, coffee, breweries, bakery + live music
★ 5 miles to Broadway bars
★ 3 Bedrooms + Bonus Room
★ 6 Beds
★ 2.5 Baths
★ Free Parking
★ High-speed WiFi
★ Smart TV in the living room with apps
★ Washer and Dryer in the home
★ Central AC + Heat
★ Dining area in the home
★ Seating on both our front patio and back patio, including a dining table 
★ Fully fenced in backyard
★ Keypad entry (no keys to worry about)
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Quiet location yet convenient access to nightlife

The space is the perfect mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. Tasteful elements incorporated throughout, modern amenities and plenty of space. This home will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville. Great location - walking distance to so many things!

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: King bed 
Bedroom 2: Queen bed
Bedroom 3: Two Full beds
Bonus Room: Two Twins beds

BATHROOMS:
Bathroom 1: Full size, connected to Bedroom 1 on first floor
Bathroom 2: Full size with shower/tub combo, on the second floor
Bathroom 3: Half bathroom located on the first floor

Please note all animals must be approved prior to booking. We have a $125 pet fee. Animals not allowed on the furniture or beds.

Nearby places that we love include: Fat Bottom Brewing Co., Hattie B's, Frothy Monkey, Red Bicycle Coffee & Crepes, Bringles BBQ, Jeni's Ice Cream, ABLE Clothing, Nicky's Coal Fired, 51 North Taproom, Brightside Bakeshop..

Guest access
You'll have the whole house to yourself!

Other things to note
Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
